title: Bitcoin Universe documentation manifest
description: Root-level docs.manifest.json declared by every public bitcoinuniverseio repository. The portal at docs.bitcoinuniverse.io ingests documentation only from repositories with a valid manifest, pinned to exact commits in sources.lock.json.

id.description: Stable documentation identifier, unique across the organization. Usually the repository name.

name.description: Human product, protocol, or component name.

classification.description: What kind of repository this is.

documentationUrl.description: The permanent home of this component's documentation on the portal.

docsRoot.description: Repository-relative directory holding the documentation content the portal may ingest. Use "." when README-level content is the documentation.

sourceRef.description: The branch the documentation content is maintained on, for example develop or main.

releasedRef.description: The tag or exact commit representing the current verified public release of this component. Omit only when lifecycle is experimental or archive.

releaseVersion.description: Current public release version string shown to readers. Omit only when lifecycle is experimental or archive.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle state using the shared terminology in bitcoinuniverseio/.github docs/lifecycle.md.

chains.description: Chains and networks this component supports. Empty array means chain-independent.

protocols.description: Protocol ids this component implements, indexes, documents, or depends on.

specifications.description: Repository-relative paths of normative specification documents, when this repository holds any.

contracts.description: Machine-readable interface contracts this repository holds.

capabilityManifest.description: Repository-relative path of the release-evidence capability manifest, when one exists.

statusSources.description: Public HTTPS endpoints the portal may poll for live status and freshness. Public endpoints only.

owners.description: GitHub teams or accounts responsible for this documentation.

upstream.description: Present when this repository derives from an upstream project.

redirects.description: Permanent redirects the portal must serve for this component's previous public routes.

lastVerified.description: The exact commit at which a maintainer last verified this manifest against reality, and when.

securityClassification.description: Everything a manifest points at must be safe for public disclosure. The only allowed value is public.

replacement.description: Replacement documentation URL or repository, or null when none exists.
